ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Psychology of Advertising Meets with ADV 590-R (CRN 56180) Description: This course is designed to familiarize students with theory and research at the intersection of advertising and psychology. It will explore issues such as: basic research methodology, the emergence of trends, attitudes and persuasion, human and brand personality, cross-cultural advertising, implicit consumer cognition, and coolness.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Advertising or Speech Communication or News-Editorial or Broadcast Journalism or Media Studies or Communication or Media and Cinema Studies major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing. Not intended for Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
